key_idea: The maximum slope over all pairs is always attained by two points adjacent in x-order, since a chord's slope is a weighted average of the adjacent slopes it spans.
sketch: Sort the points by x and take the maximum of |z[i+1]-z[i]| / (x[i+1]-x[i]) over adjacent pairs; O(n log n). x differences reach 2e9 so keep them in 64-bit, and use long double for the division; print with enough digits for the 1e-4 absolute tolerance. Stress test not needed beyond samples; all three samples pass.
